# BTicino C300X Native Agent Integration v0.6.1

Home Assistant integration hotfix for WebRTC audio handling and ICE candidate
ordering.

## Fixed

- Requests door-station audio whenever the browser WebRTC offer can receive
  audio. Microphone/talkback support remains gated separately by the browser
  offer.
- Buffers early trickle ICE candidates until the peer connection has a remote
  description, avoiding noisy `addIceCandidate` race warnings from aiortc
  without dropping browser candidates.

## Notes

- The native C300X device agent is unchanged from `0.6.0`.
- This release keeps the Home Assistant minimum version at `2026.5.0`.
